display.description: This profile is modeled after the La Marzocco Linea Mini pressure and water debit on a .8mm restrictor. Given that at 9bars of pressure, the calculated flow rate is of 13.30ml/s, using a simple orifice flow model we get to this high flow 6 bar limit profile. This profile only has one stage, a high flow fill at 11.3ml/s until a 6bar pressure limit is achieved and then flow declines, the recommended dose and ratio is 1:2, aiming at about 28 to 30 seconds. If you enjoy 9bar shots then change the variables to 9 bar and 13.3ml/s flow.
